text:
Raphael Lavoie waited a long time for his first NHL goal. The Oilers' 2019 second-round pick went 17 NHL games without one before this season, then scored on Oct. 27 in a 4-1 win over Ottawa. KTNV's headline said it plainly: "Raphael Lavoie scores his 1st NHL goal."

He has one goal and two assists in 13 games as a fourth-liner, about 10 minutes a night, though his ice time dropped to around 7.5 minutes in mid-November and he hasn't played since Nov. 17. At 6-foot-4 he plays a physical game, with 29 hits.

The process is mixed. His own chances are decent for the minutes (1.27 individual expected goals, the quality of his shots), and he's shooting 8.3%, below the 10 to 16% range we'd expect from him, so a goal or two has gone missing. But at five on five Vegas gets 46% of the expected goals with him on, about eight points worse than without him. He scored 25 goals in 61 AHL games for Bakersfield in 2022-23, so the finish is there. Watch whether he gets back into the lineup and keeps the shots coming.
